title: Tech Note: 4D View Pro Pivot Table Builder
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note builds a manual pivot-table tool using ORDA entity selections and v18R2 View Pro commands; it's still a technically valid approach today, though 4D View Pro has since gained a native, built-in Pivot Table feature that makes this hand-rolled implementation largely unnecessary for new projects.
related_updates: 4D View Pro added a native Pivot Table / Pivot Panel feature in later versions, making custom pivot-builders like this one mostly a historical/educational exercise rather than the recommended approach
ORDA (introduced ~v16-17) is now the standard, fully current way to query data, exactly as used here
